answer: Prism-Saffron Pigment Meter (PSPM): each multi-agent action carries a pigment = H(agent_secret, saffron epoch salt, action); the protocol builds a prism tree over pigment prefixes. A coordination event is accepted only after every prism leaf supplies a distinct verifiable-delay proof of D sequential steps, with D scaled by leaf count. Honest agents batch into few leaves and amortize D; a Sybil swarm splitting into N leaves must compute N distinct VDF chains per epoch, so mass coordination costs N×D sequential work plus fresh pigment entropy. Clones collide and are rejected.
